items.headline_en: Qwen4-Max now available on AI Gateway
items.summary_en: Qwen4-Max from Alibaba is now available on AI Gateway. It is the first model in the Qwen4 series: a reasoning model with native vision and a 1M-token context window, built for coding, professional work, and long-running agent tasks.Qwen4-Max is better at working with professional tools. It can build 3D scenes in Blender and playable games in Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot, running what it builds and using visual feedback to fix camera, animation, and lighting issues.
